title: Our Week at School
paragraphs: Class 6A – Our timetable at Colegio San Martín. School starts at 7:30 every day and finishes at 2:00, but on Friday we finish at 12:00. Break is at 10:00.
Monday: Maths at 7:30, English at 8:30 and Science at 10:30. After lunch we have Art.
Tuesday: Spanish at 7:30, then Maths. At 10:30 we have Music and at 12:00 we have Computers.
Wednesday: English at 7:30 and at 8:30. This is my favourite day!
Thursday: Science and Geography. We don't have Maths on Thursday.
Friday: PE at 7:30. We play basketball in the yard. Then we have Spanish and Art. The weekend starts early!

title: Football Trials This Wednesday
paragraphs: ATTENTION, ALL STUDENTS! Football trials for the school team are on Wednesday at 3:30 in the afternoon. Come to the big field behind the gym.
Boys and girls from Grade 5 to Grade 7 can try. You don't need to be a champion. You need to run, pass the ball and have fun!
Please bring your sports shoes, a bottle of water and a letter from your parents. There aren't any balls at the field, so bring your own ball if you can.
The coach is Mr Ramírez. He is friendly and he loves football. The first game is on 15 March against Colegio Bolívar. See you on the field!

title: Greetings from Cusco
focus: Present continuous for actions now and plans
paragraphs: Dear Abuela,
Greetings from Cusco! The weather is sunny today. It is cold in the morning, but it is warm in the afternoon. I'm here with my friend Rosa and her parents.
Cusco is a beautiful old city. The streets are narrow and the houses are white. There is a big square with a church and many cafés. We are staying in a small hotel near the market.
Right now we are having lunch at a restaurant. I'm eating chicken soup and Rosa is drinking hot chocolate. Tomorrow we're going to Machu Picchu by train. I can't wait!
Kisses and hugs, Valeria

title: Today at the Sol Cafeteria
focus: Food and prices; there is / there are
paragraphs: Welcome to the Sol Cafeteria! We are open from 10:00 to 1:30, Monday to Friday.
Snacks: a cheese sandwich ($2), a banana ($1) and a fruit salad ($2). Milk or orange juice: $1.
Today's lunch: chicken with rice and salad ($4). For vegetarians: vegetable soup with bread ($3). Every lunch has a free glass of water.
Desserts: ice cream ($1.50) and chocolate cake ($2). We don't have coffee, and we don't sell fizzy drinks. Healthy food is good for your brain!

title: My First Day at a New School
focus: Past simple of be: was / were
paragraphs: Monday, 3 February. Dear diary,
Today was my first day at a new school. I was nervous in the morning. My mum was with me at the gate.
My classroom is big and bright. There are twenty-two students. My teacher is Ms Ortega. She was very kind and funny. The boy next to me is Nico. He was friendly, too.
At break, Nico, Sara and Ana were in the yard with a basketball. I can play basketball, so they were happy. Now we are friends.
Lunch was good: rice, beans and chicken. I was tired at home, but I was happy. School isn't scary now!

title: The Robot and the Banana
paragraphs: Panel 1. Robot Beto is in the kitchen. He is hungry. Beto: 'I'm hungry! Is there any food?'
Panel 2. There is a yellow banana on the table. Beto: 'A banana! I can eat it.' He takes the banana.
Panel 3. Beto is looking for his mouth. He can't find it. Beto: 'Where is my mouth? I'm a robot. I don't have a mouth!'
Panel 4. Lucía comes in. Lucía: 'Beto, what are you doing?' Beto: 'I'm looking for my mouth!' Lucía laughs. 'You don't eat bananas, Beto. You use batteries!'
Panel 5. Lucía gives Beto a new battery. Beto: 'Thank you, Lucía! Now I'm happy. And you can have the banana!'

title: Visit the Magic Water Park
focus: There is / there are; can / can't
paragraphs: Visit the Magic Water Park in the city centre! It is open every day from 3:00 in the afternoon to 10:00 at night.
There are twelve big fountains with colourful lights. At night, there is also a music and light show. The show starts at 7:30 and 9:00.
Tickets: children under five are free. Children from five to twelve pay $2. Adults pay $4. You can buy tickets at the main gate.
You can walk, take photos and play in the small water garden. You can't swim in the fountains, and you can't bring pets. There is a café near the exit.

title: Meet Camila, the Young Swimmer
paragraphs: Meet Camila Reyes, a young swimmer from Guayaquil. She is thirteen years old and she is in Grade 8.
Camila swims six days a week. She gets up at five o'clock and goes to the pool with her father. Her training lasts two hours. After training, she has breakfast and goes to school.
Camila can swim very fast. Her best event is the 100 metres. She isn't tall, but she is strong. She doesn't eat sweets, and she drinks a lot of water.
Her dream is the Olympic Games. 'I can do it!' she says. In her free time, she reads books and listens to music with her little sister.

title: Come to My Film Night!
paragraphs: Hi everyone,
Join us for a film night on Friday, 20 June! It is at my house, at 6:00 in the evening.
The film is an animal adventure. It is about a small dog and a big bear. The film is one hour and forty minutes long.
Please bring a pillow and a blanket. We have the popcorn and the lemonade. Do you have a favourite snack? Bring it to share!
My house is at 25 Pine Street, next to the pharmacy. The party finishes at 9:30. Tell me by Wednesday: can you come?
Your friend, Joaquín

title: My Pet Turtle, Pepe
paragraphs: Hello, readers! This is my blog about my pet. His name is Pepe and he is a turtle. He is five years old and he lives in our garden.
Pepe is small and green. He has a hard shell on his back. His favourite food is lettuce, but he also eats tomatoes and small pieces of apple. He doesn't eat meat.
Pepe is slow, but he isn't boring! He can swim in his little pond, and he can climb on a big stone. At night he sleeps in a small wooden house.
In winter, it is cold, so Pepe sleeps for many weeks. I can't play with him, but I check his house every day. Do you have a pet? Tell me about it in the comments!
